en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a city square with a large central statue on a pedestal, formal paths and trees around it, and substantial buildings in the background, framed by mountains. There is printed red text identifying the view as Piazza Dante and Imperial-Hôtel in Trento. The lower part and right side contain handwritten Italian correspondence in ink.
